title: Chapter 16 Reversal
content:
Chapter 16 Reversal

It seems to be some kind of existence in the dark, probably the so-called Ancestral God of Denier! Hear the call of all in and the heart, and give a response.

This kind of ancestral god is similar to the totem worship in ancient China. Because of the fear of all kinds of things in the wild age, the kind of environment where you may lose your life at any time and die somewhere.

For everything around him, he is full of awe. If there is any beast, he has killed a lot of his own clansmen, and out of fear of him, he forms a kind of primitive worship that is similar to morbidity.

Or, who is very brave in your own tribe? Use his prowess to lead his tribe to power and hunt for more food. Then for the inhuman bravery of the warriors, the tribe of barbarians who do not have much knowledge. He will also be worshipped as a god.

"Denair, the great God of Menghu, heard your prayers and calls. Now my descendants have come to the moment of life and death. I have understood your current situation, and now, I will give you my temporary power. , give you stronger martial arts. Go, kill the man who is on the high platform, he is the leader of this army, kill him, this army will win without a fight." The God of Menghu is somewhat holy The voice resounded in Denier's heart.

The God of Menghu, that is his idol. Since he was a child, he has listened to his myths and legends, and slowly grew up to become a brave warrior like him, which is his lifelong pursuit.

His tribe was not originally called Mengla, but was just an unknown small tribe with only a few dozen people around. Today, the most powerful tribe in the surrounding twenty miles has risen because of him.

He has shown unparalleled martial arts since he was a child, and he hunted down the second-order monster Menghu, who needed dozens of people to work together at that time, and could not be killed. When he carried the second-order monster alone, he returned to the tribe. At that time, all the people were shocked, and fell to their knees and kissed his toes with their mouths to show their submission.

The old patriarch at that time, under the leadership of the sacrificial priest, came to the high platform to worship the ancestors, and passed down his position as the patriarch. Moreover, the warrior changed the tribe to his own name on the spot - Munra. In the days that followed, the people of the Mengla tribe lived an unprecedentedly good life, led by their leader. Led the tribe to get rich food and a safe environment.

After that, young and aggressive, he came to the surrounding tribes with glory all over his body. He used his bravery to gather some small tribes around him to give them safe shelter and help them hunt enough food. This kind of favorable conditions at the time gathered them together and became a group of hundreds of people in one fell swoop. The middle tribe, famous within a hundred miles, all tribes have heard of the name Munla.

Although, he is already dead, and has been an ancestral god for hundreds of years under the title "God of Menghu". But the legend of the founder of this tribe is still circulating.

Hearing the Ancestral God that he had always worshiped, the voice echoed in his heart. While Denell's heart was full of excitement, he also recalled the reminder of the ancestors.

Therefore, Denell looked forward, the coach who was standing on the high platform with an indifferent expression and could not see any expression, that is, their lord, the man named Zhong Yu.

He is the soul of this elite force, the center of everyone. Only he can turn the tide of this battle. There was such a realization in Denier's heart.

Although Denell was unified, all the men from the small tribes except himself and Anderson's tribe also admired them very much. However, all can be thrown away at the command of the ancestral god I have always admired and respected for the survival of the tribe.

With a roar, Denier abandoned the opponent in front of him and rushed towards the high platform. Around, soldiers rushed to block their path, but they were all defeated by one blow.

With the power bestowed by the ancestral god, Denell's strength has just touched the threshold of the second-order, and has reached the point of being proficient in the second-order. Denell had never felt so full of power in his body at this time.

That feeling made me addicted, waiting and even unimaginable. Later, if the Ancestral God took back this power, can I still bear the feeling of losing my power and survive.

Slowly, Denier broke through the layers of obstacles and approached the high platform step by step. He was about to approach Zhong Yu, and there were only four guards beside him, and he didn't look very powerful. How could he stop his own footsteps? "His head, I've got it!" Denell said with a firm tone in his heart.

"You dare to be a thief, Daniel is here, don't be arrogant!" Wang Daniel originally thought that those soldiers could stop Denier. But who would have thought that these soldiers are so useless, so afraid of death, that they dare not even block them. Often let him rush to the high platform without encountering any fierce resistance along the way.

Seeing this, Wang Daniu couldn't hold back, roared, gave up his enemy, and let his subordinates block the side to see Denell's great power, about to kill his commander, and inflamed his morale, trying to stop his savagery people. He rushed over and fought with that Denell.

Seeing that very brave enemy general rushing towards him, Denier didn't dare to be careless, he stopped quickly, raised his weapon, and faced Wang Daniel. Before solving this great enemy, I would not dare to face the siege of this great enemy and those soldiers.

When Wang Daniu saw that, the tribal leader stopped, waiting for him to rush over, and he was relieved. Although he joined with his subordinates to surround and kill the barbarian, he was more certain, but he still did not dare to joke about the safety of justice.

After all, the safety of Zhong Yu alone is related to the safety of thousands of people in the entire Luoyang City! How can this be used as a joke? He and the family members of the whole army are still in Luoyang City. If the entire army is defeated because of Zhong Yu's death, then his sins will be great, and he will not forgive himself.

He came to Denell and stared at the man who almost caused his entire army to lose the battle for a while, without saying a word. Immediately, Wang Daniu waved his knife fiercely and slashed at Denier, but Denier did not show weakness and waved at Wang Daniel. Holding the machete in his hand, he also went up.

With the sound of "Touch!", the shield and the knife in his hand almost flew away, but Wang Daniu did his best to clench the handle, and held the machete in his hand dangerously and dangerously.

His hands were aching, and the tiger's mouth was split open. Wang Daniu looked at the other party with a serious face, and couldn't help but raise a little bit of vigilance in his heart. His intuition from years of fighting on the battlefield told him that if he wasn't serious, he had a good chance of dying.

Denell looked at the other party, and he was very surprised that this person could take the power of his own blow. You must know that he is not just touching the second-order, and he can only superficially trigger the strength of Dou Qi. But it has been a long time since entering the second-order, and has mastered the strength of all the abilities of the second-order.

Thinking of this, Denell couldn't help but look excited. He looked straight at each other, and he was able to find an evenly matched opponent, and at a time when his strength was skyrocketing, he was still very uncomfortable. In this small battlefield, it is not easy. I hope he can bring himself a lot of fun and not die so quickly.

If you can bring more pressure to yourself and let yourself have a good understanding of this power that does not belong to you, then you can bring more experience for yourself to be able to advance to second-order mastery in the future.

Things are getting more and more interesting, and Denell's heart is full of expectations.
